items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20

ctx.x: And then Celestan must have been before that.

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: Well, I was going right on playing with a fella called Duck Hunter.

ctx.x: No, he left here about 22 to join Long. Yeah, he was four years. So, you got here in 1919. That's right. So we got it down to about three years, Sam.

Yeah, 1919 I came back. Well, I was going right on playing with a fella called Duck Hunter. Did you ever know him? Then Jack Kelly Stoeman was from Duck Hunter. So I worked with Jack for a long time. But Jack didn't have no brass band, but he paraded too. Jack, been in parades too. Was he a member of a regular brass band or a jumper?
Yeah, he was before I came back.
